purpose: Empty employee registry template. Copy to private instance/employees.json before adding people. Never store real employee records in this tracked file.
default_rules: Use this file to identify humans, roles, responsibilities, communication handles, and agent mappings.
Do not store sensitive personal notes in this root file.
Do not contact employees unless the current acquisition mode and approval scope allow it.
Employee agents collect signal and feedback; they do not manage, discipline, evaluate, or make HR promises.
Personal notes and memory should live beside the relevant employee agent profile.

schema.name: human readable name
schema.notes_policy: personal notes and memory go in memory_path, not employees.json
